name: What kind of plumbing inspections are performed during new home construction?

mainEntity.name: What kind of plumbing inspections are performed during new home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: During new home construction, several plumbing inspections are performed to ensure compliance with local building codes and safety standards. Typically, there's a 'rough-in' inspection after all supply and drain lines are installed but before walls are closed. This checks pipe sizing, materials, connections, and proper venting. A 'top-out' inspection may occur to verify connections to the roof. Finally, a 'final' inspection is conducted once all fixtures are installed and the system is fully operational, checking for leaks, proper drainage, and adequate water pressure. Alpha-Plumbing Services ensures all our work passes these critical inspections in areas like Goodyear, Buckeye, and Avondale.
acceptedAnswer.description: New home plumbing involves rough-in, top-out, and final inspections to ensure code compliance, safety, and proper system function.
